name: Getbol, Korean Tidal Flats
description: Getbol are the vast tidal mudflats along South Korea's southwestern, southern and western coasts, on the Yellow Sea. Six separate areas cover river mouths, open shores, island clusters and semi-enclosed bays. At low tide they become rich feeding grounds for 216 bird species, including the critically rare Spoon-billed Sandpiper, and are home to thousands of other plants and animals.
